| description = Rumored to be carrying [[Lady Vox]]'s treasure hoard with her, this Ice Dragon can be found wandering the wastes of the Dreadlands, usually in the snowy parts near the tunnel to portal valley.

Added [[Patch_notes#Dragons | August 9, 2000]] about 2 months into Hole Era.

=== Strategy ===

Generally regarded as the most difficult of the Kunark outdoor dragons.

This dragon has the standard fear AOE, a nigh-unresistable AOE cold slow + DD and the ability to cast Complete Heal. As a result, this dragon tends to die very slowly compared to many other Kunark bosses.

One approach is for melee to dispel themselves with something like [[Crystallized Pumice]] or [[Summoned: Staff of Runes]] so as to remove the slow AE.
